outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of ultrasound for SGA prediction
Obstetric outcomes (planned preterm delivery, elective Cesarean section)
Neonatal health status (5-min Apgar score, cord blood pH at birth, need for neonatal resuscitation)
cohort: Pregnant women recruited from two French university maternity centers between 2003 and 2006
finding: Third-trimester ultrasound screening for SGA had poor performance, missing a large number of SGA neonates and potentially leading to unnecessary interventions without improving neonatal outcomes.
